title: Seeds for Everyone

readiness.math: sharing equally: division by dealing out (older: with a remainder)
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Our beans made so many seeds! I'd like every neighbor to have some for their own gardens.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Let's share them out fairly. One for each, round and round.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Share the seeds so every neighbor has the same.

older.prompt: Share the seeds fairly among five. Any that can't be shared fairly go in the left-over bowl.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: A seed shared becomes a garden shared. Next year the whole valley will have beans!

journal_line: I shared bean seeds fairly with all the neighbors.
unavailable_text: The seeds are shared for today.
